audit_policy.local_closure: Syntactic branch closure retains entry-dependent unreachable paths as candidates.
audit_policy.transitive_mapping: A000 maps bank18 until a mapper transfer; 8000 requires an independent mapper state; unresolved paths are excluded from complete proofs.
audit_policy.unresolved_transfer_scope: Candidate closure boundaries require mapper and indirect-target evidence before further instruction paths can be confirmed.

state_statuses.label: 已确认
state_statuses.description: 界面状态及其职责已有文字、运行画面、调用关系或构造数据证据。

state_statuses.label: 候选
state_statuses.description: 构造入口尚未确认，采样画面不确立状态身份。

state_statuses.label: 类型已推定
state_statuses.description: 资产边界和内容已确认，但尚缺调用点或完整运行状态证据。

state_statuses.label: 待解析
state_statuses.description: 只确认候选入口、流程位置或业务大类；不得当作已完成画面。

state_statuses.label: 不可达
state_statuses.description: 调度表、命令指针与调用者检索未找到本 ROM 的可达入口；保留目录证据，不发布界面或候选模板。

state_ui_roles.label: 可见界面
state_ui_roles.description: 可独立观察、截图或重建的稳定界面、窗口或消息状态。

state_ui_roles.label: 界面动作
state_ui_roles.description: 输入处理、值更新、效果分派或播放操作；本身没有独立可见界面身份。

state_ui_roles.label: 流程转换
state_ui_roles.description: 开始、结束、返回或模式切换边；本身没有稳定画面身份。

state_ui_roles.label: 运行上下文
state_ui_roles.description: 承载界面的场景、战斗或系统背景；保留为目录证据但不计作界面。

state_identity_contract.label: localized-display-label-and-current-runtime-foreign-key

ui_roles.screen: a stable, independently visible UI composition or modal view
ui_roles.action: an input handler or operation without an independent view
ui_roles.transition: a lifecycle or mode boundary without a stable view
ui_roles.context: visible environmental context that supports UI but is not UI

state_identity_contract.screen_count_rule: only reachable states whose ui_role is screen contribute to screen totals; unreachable states remain catalogued without screen identities or preview bindings
state_identity_contract.confirmed_evidence_rule: confirmed requires at least one resolved record, layout, dispatch command, runtime scene, reconstruction preview, or symbol; notes alone are not evidence
state_identity_contract.handler_rule: dispatch handlers are transitions/actions; a handler is not promoted to a screen without composition evidence

coverage_contract.runtime-sampled: 至少一个状态已有独立 PPU 成品与 Mesen 像素审计；不表示该界面的全部状态已验证，运行画面也不是回写源。
coverage_contract.static-structure-rendered: 已有 ROM 脚本布局和 CHR 的结构预览；动态字段尚未组成成品。
coverage_contract.source-assets-only: 文本/数据/代码入口已定位，但尚无可靠的完整构图预览。
coverage_contract.editing: 当前只预览；所有入口和原始范围为后续编辑保留。
